## Workload

Daniel Roche completed 709 reads during the review period, recording 441 hours of work. This equates to 1.6 reads per hour. The workload information provides a clear summary of activity for the period and supports review of the grader’s output. The figures were considered by Priya Anand as part of the review.

## Quality

A total of 64 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 73.4 per cent. Priya Anand reviewed the available workload and quality information for Daniel Roche, including the number of reads completed, hours recorded, reads checked, and the resulting agreement measure. Together, these figures provide the basis for the assessment of workload and quality during the period.
